editorial.evidence: Re-review against all 63 captured sections. The previous Complete version mapped one row per section with shared boilerplate evidence, and several of those rows claimed content the page did not contain. Restored or corrected: the full-pack six-row Situation/Default/Why decision table (previously claimed but absent); the stakeholder table; the related-case anchor table; the four dangerous assumptions and three safe defaults; the request-to-path table; the pressure/design-response table; the risk register's mitigations and triggers (only owners survived); the three cross-layer metric readings; the canary and operability rationale; full ITSM record signatures; the parent-document p95 under 2 s target and the CRAG-over-Self-RAG and per-source alpha reasons; the case_123 JSON body; both 90-second scripts, the two-minute answer, the concise close, the eight lines, the four trade-offs, the OpenAI decomposition and the marketplace scenario. Fixed meaning drift in two places: the approval-queue sentence (source says most requests should never reach a human, measured) and the Monday pilot ('approval-required refunds below a small threshold', which the previous text had changed). The nine follow-ups and the cost pivot moved from visible tables into answer reveals so they can be attempted first; check-yourself answers now carry the source's full wording. Source inconsistencies resolved in text (2026-11-16): two different 60-minute allocations → one plan, the full design's minute table (content to minute 50, ten minutes for interruptions), with coarse blocks recomputed from it as 10/12/15/8/5, because it is the only allocation tied to the walkthrough steps; Case signature omitting version → version included, because the write contract uses Case.version for optimistic concurrency; six versus seven decision-table rows → six policies, with the evidence table explained as listing order status as two cases. Meta-commentary about the source removed. Arithmetic rechecked (4.2M calls, 2.2M-2.4M retrievals, 67k/day, 2.5 s triage budget). The brief now opens on the double charge, defines routed decision pipeline, gateway and idempotency, and adds audience and prerequisites, because the source's who/objectives/assumes were mapped but not stated before.
